intro.en: Strong winds strip roofs and bring down trees and power lines. A roof tied down and a yard kept clear are the work of every dry season.
intro.sw: Upepo mkali huvua paa na kuangusha miti na nyaya za umeme. Paa lililofungwa vizuri na uwanja uliowekwa wazi ni kazi ya kila kiangazi.

en: Know the months when strong winds come here and the places where they have taken roofs and trees; the committee keeps the record.
Know the strong buildings (the school, the mosque, the church, the office) agreed as shelters, and keep them open to all.
sw: Fahamuni miezi ambayo upepo mkali huja hapa na maeneo ambayo umewahi kuvua paa na kuangusha miti; kamati inatunza kumbukumbu.
Fahamuni majengo imara (shule, msikiti, kanisa, ofisi) yaliyokubaliwa kama makimbilio, na yawe wazi kwa wote.

en: Tie down roofing sheets, fix loose doors and windows, and strengthen the corners of the house each dry season.
Trim trees near the house and the power line, and keep loose objects off the roof and the yard.
sw: Fungeni vizuri mabati, rekebisheni milango na madirisha yaliyolegea, na imarisheni pembe za nyumba kila kiangazi.
Punguzeni matawi ya miti karibu na nyumba na nyaya za umeme, na ondoeni vitu vilivyolegea juu ya paa na uwanjani.

en: Keep life jackets on board, check the weather information from TMA and the beach management unit before every trip, and keep the boat maintained.
sw: Kuweni na maboya ya kuokolea chomboni, angalieni taarifa za hali ya hewa za TMA na kitengo cha usimamizi wa mwalo kabla ya kila safari, na tunzeni chombo.

who.sw: Kamati za kijiji, mtaa na kata

en: Keep schools, markets and places of worship checked for weak roofs and leaning trees, and agree where people shelter in a storm.
sw: Kagueni shule, masoko na nyumba za ibada kwa paa dhaifu na miti inayoinama, na kubalianeni watu wanajikinga wapi wakati wa dhoruba.

en: Apply the roofing and tie-down standards in building permits and school repairs; TANESCO keeps the lines clear of trees.
sw: Tumieni viwango vya paa na ufungaji kwenye vibali vya ujenzi na ukarabati wa shule; TANESCO iweke nyaya mbali na miti.

en: Build with hipped roofs, hurricane straps and short overhangs, and agree an inner room or a strong building as the shelter.
sw: Jengeni paa zenye mteremko pande zote, vifungo vya chuma vya paa na mapaa yasiyotokeza sana, na kubalianeni chumba cha ndani au jengo imara kama kimbilio.

en: Strengthen the roofs of schools, clinics and markets in the windiest wards first, and keep the response team and the lines of supply ready for the season.
sw: Imarisheni paa za shule, zahanati na masoko katika kata zenye upepo mkali zaidi kwanza, na wekeni timu ya kukabiliana na njia za usambazaji tayari kwa msimu.
